    ENDWHILE
    RETURN Mid
ENDFUNCTION

items.answer: RETURN Mid at the end should be RETURN -1 so that "not found" can be detected.

items.stem:
Zara is comparing two programs that check a list of usernames for duplicates at Coral Bay Aquarium. (a) State the time complexity of this code and justify it:
Count ← 0
FOR i ← 1 TO N
    FOR j ← 1 TO N
        IF Values[i] = Values[j] THEN
            Count ← Count + 1
        ENDIF
    NEXT j
NEXT i (b) Explain why an O(n log n) algorithm is preferred to an O(n²) algorithm for large data sets. (c) An O(n²) program takes 2 s for 20,000 records. Estimate the time for 80,000 records.
items.answer: (a) O(n²) (b) n log n grows much more slowly; e.g. for n = 1 000 000, ≈ 2 × 10⁷ vs 10¹² steps. (c) 32 s
items.markingKey: (a) 1 mark complexity; 1 mark reason [2] (b) 1 mark each [2] (c) × 4² = × 16 [1]; 32 s [1] [2]
